column1: # The Sideeye each filing campaign ran, for the "Sideeye" column of docs/found.md.
# One row per campaign in spike/outcome-funnel-campaigns.tsv that filed a report;
# spike/outcome-funnel.py check is red when a campaign that filed one has no row here.
# A campaign that only re-measured an earlier filing needs none.
# Columns (tab-separated, exactly three, TABS not spaces):
#   version  X.Y.Z       the campaign's record says it ran the released vX.Y.Z
#            X.Y.Z+main  anything else: a build from the checkout, or a record that
#                        names no engine. X.Y.Z is `git describe` of the commit that
#                        added the record - the last tag before the run, as near as
#   basis    where the version was read, so a reader can check it
# Not derived from the campaign's date: three tags went out on 2026-08-13, and the
# 2026-08-15 re-measurement ran on main the day v0.8.0 was tagged. A date picks one
# and is wrong about the rest.
